protocol.shared_start_stop: Identical supervisor, 60 kW stable-power floor, and 1.5 g/start proxy for OOL and scenario MPC.
protocol.baseline: Candidate-specific same-seed realistic dynamic OOL; no baseline is carried across a start/stop setting.
protocol.validity_rule: terminal SOC error <= 0.01, traction shortage <= 1 W, proxy violations <= 1 W/rpm, zero fallback, and zero forecast ramp-envelope infeasibility
protocol.selection_rule: Rank fully certified candidates on six development seeds; test two finalists on 14 disjoint holdout seeds.
